daas-irab:1-3.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَصَدُّوا﴾ conjoined to كفروا. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَضَلَّ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of الذين, and the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَآمَنُوا﴾ conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what precedes them. ﴿نُزِّلَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ its khabar. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial); the nominal clause is parenthetical and has no grammatical position. ﴿كَفَّرَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سَيِّئاتِهِمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿وَأَصْلَحَ بالَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to kaffara عنهم. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَنَّ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, and anna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its noun. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the ṣila. ﴿اتَّبَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿الْباطِلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْحَقَّ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يَضْرِبُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿أَمْثالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:4-6.t: ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إذا is an adverbial conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿لَقِيتُمُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَضَرْبَ﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis of the condition, and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿الرِّقابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of beginning (ibtidāʾ). ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverbial conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿أَثْخَنْتُمُوهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فَشُدُّوا﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْوَثاقَ﴾ its object; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of resumption and of consequence (tafrīʿ), and immā is a particle of condition and of detailing (tafṣīl). ﴿مَنًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿بَعْدُ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿وَإِمَّا فِداءً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿حَتَّى تَضَعَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after حتى. ﴿الْحَرْبُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَوْزارَها﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and they [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) فداء. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and law is a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the verbal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَانْتَصَرَ﴾ the lām falls in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative (muhmal). ﴿لِيَبْلُوَا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), with its fāʿil latent. ﴿بَعْضَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِبَعْضٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar from an and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and they are attached to an implied, omitted verb. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿قُتِلُوا﴾ a passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a ḍamma (اللَّهُ); as muḍāf ilayhi it is اللَّهِ.] ﴿فَلَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and lan is a particle causing the accusative. ﴿يُضِلَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by lan, its fāʿil latent. ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿سَيَهْدِيهِمْ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيُصْلِحُ بالَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to سيهديهم. ﴿وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ﴾ conjoined to سيهديهم. ﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَرَّفَها﴾ a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the verbal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of al-janna.

daas-irab:7-11.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ yā is a vocative particle, hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ayy is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿تَنْصُرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَنْصُرْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the kāf is its object and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدامَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to ينصركم. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَتَعْساً﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تعسا. ﴿وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾ a preposition, and anna and its noun. ﴿كَرِهُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause كرهوا is the khabar (predicate) of anna. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from anna and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and they [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to كرهوا. ﴿أَفَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and lam is a particle causing the jussive. ﴿يَسِيرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَيَنْظُرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿كَيْفَ كانَ﴾ an interrogative noun, the fronted khabar of kāna. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾ its postponed noun. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [element that is the] ṣila of the relative noun; the clause kāna stands in place of the object of ينظروا. ﴿دَمَّرَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿أَمْثالُها﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَى﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of الذين, and the interpreted maṣdar from anna and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and they are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَأَنَّ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, which works like inna. ﴿مَوْلَى﴾ its noun. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, its khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of anna.

daas-irab:12-14.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يُدْخِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of جنات. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَتَمَتَّعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿وَيَأْكُلُونَ﴾ conjoined to يتمتعون. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a particle of comparison and of the genitive, and mā is maṣdariyya (yielding a verbal noun). ﴿تَأْكُلُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الْأَنْعامُ﴾ fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from mā and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and they [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَالنَّارُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَثْوىً﴾ its khabar. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to mathwan; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكَأَيِّنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and كأين is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾ tamyīz (specification), genitive in form. ﴿هِيَ أَشَدُّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ tamyīz; the clause كأين is resumptive, and the clause hiya ashaddu is an adjective of qarya. ﴿مِنْ قَرْيَتِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ashaddu. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ an adjective of qaryatika. ﴿أَخْرَجَتْكَ﴾ a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَهْلَكْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar of كأين. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and lā is the lā of generic negation, which works like inna. ﴿ناصِرَ﴾ its noun. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, its khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and man is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is latent. ﴿عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of kāna; the verbal clause is the ṣila, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of bayyina. ﴿كَمَنْ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ man. ﴿زُيِّنَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سُوءُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿عَمَلِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the verbal clause is the ṣila of man. ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:15-16.t: ﴿مَثَلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْجَنَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّتِي﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of al-janna. ﴿وُعِدَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿الْمُتَّقُونَ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِيها﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْهارٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ ماءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, an adjective of أنهار. ﴿غَيْرِ﴾ an adjective. ﴿آسِنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause فيها أنهار is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ mathal. ﴿وَأَنْهارٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam. ﴿طَعْمُهُ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is an adjective of laban. ﴿وَأَنْهارٌ مِنْ خَمْرٍ﴾ also conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَذَّةٍ﴾ an adjective of khamr. ﴿لِلشَّارِبِينَ﴾ an adjective of ladhdha. ﴿وَأَنْهارٌ مِنْ عَسَلٍ مُصَفًّى﴾ conjoined to the one before it. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and lahum is a fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, an adjective of the omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿الثَّمَراتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمَغْفِرَةٌ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and maghfira is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, an adjective of maghfira. ﴿كَمَنْ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُوَ خالِدٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is the ṣila of man. ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالد. ﴿وَسُقُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿ماءٍ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (ماءٍ); in the verse it is the accusative ماءً.] ﴿حَمِيماً﴾ an adjective of ماء; the clause is conjoined to the ṣila clause. ﴿فَقَطَّعَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَمْعاءَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and minhum is a fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of beginning (ibtidāʾ). ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverbial conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿خَرَجُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis of a condition that does not cause the jussive. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿الْعِلْمَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ماذا﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila, on the view that dhā is a relative noun. ﴿آنِفاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿طَبَعَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:17-19.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اهْتَدَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿زادَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its first object, with its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿هُدىً﴾ its second object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَآتاهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being latent. ﴿تَقْواهُمْ﴾ its second object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and hal is an interrogative particle. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿السَّاعَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of الساعة. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of causation (taʿlīl), and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَ أَشْراطُها﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is causal and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and أنى is an interrogative noun, the fronted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "deliverance" (الخلاص). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverbial conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿جاءَتْهُمْ ذِكْراهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَاعْلَمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿لا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in verse 8 of al-Dukhān; the nominal clause is the khabar of anna, the interpreted maṣdar from anna and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of اعلم, and the clause اعلم is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرْ﴾ an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِذَنْبِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ﴾ its object. ﴿وَمَثْواكُمْ﴾ conjoined to it; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:20-23.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿نُزِّلَتْ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿سُورَةٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إذا is an adverbial conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿أُنْزِلَتْ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿سُورَةٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿مُحْكَمَةٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَذُكِرَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿فِيهَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْقِتالُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿رَأَيْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its object; the clause is the apodosis of a condition that does not cause the jussive, and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿نَظَرَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿الْمَغْشِيِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to al-maghshiyy. ﴿مِنَ الْمَوْتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to it. ﴿فَأَوْلى﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أولى is a verbal noun (ism fiʿl) of the past, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it. ﴿طاعَةٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted. ﴿وَقَوْلٌ﴾ conjoined to طاعة. ﴿مَعْرُوفٌ﴾ an adjective of qawl. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إذا is an adverbial conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿عَزَمَ الْأَمْرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فَلَوْ﴾ the fāʾ is a particle falling in the apodosis of إذا, and law is a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿صَدَقُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَكانَ﴾ the lām falls in the apodosis of law, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ its khabar. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to khayran; the clause لكان is the apodosis of law and has no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source reads «جواب لولا محل لها», evidently «جواب لو لا محل لها» run together.] ﴿فَهَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and hal is an interrogative particle. ﴿عَسَيْتُمْ﴾ عسى and its noun. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿تَوَلَّيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is initial and has no grammatical position, and the clause عسيتم is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحامَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to an تفسدوا; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is the khabar of عسى. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَعَنَهُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَأَصَمَّهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَعْمى أَبْصارَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to فأصمهم.

daas-irab:24-28.t: ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and lā is negative. ﴿يَتَدَبَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction in the sense of bal. ﴿عَلى قُلُوبٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَقْفالُها﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿ارْتَدُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلى أَدْبارِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (yielding a verbal noun). ﴿تَبَيَّنَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْهُدَى﴾ its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from mā and the verb is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿سَوَّلَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَأَمْلى لَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to sawwala lahum. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of anna, and the interpreted maṣdar from anna and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿كَرِهُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of الذين. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of mā. ﴿سَنُطِيعُكُمْ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فِي بَعْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَمْرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِسْرارَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an interrogative noun, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿تَوَفَّتْهُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿يَضْرِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿وُجُوهَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَدْبارَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to وجوههم; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ذلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوا﴾ see verse 26. ﴿ما أَسْخَطَ﴾ mā is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَكَرِهُوا رِضْوانَهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:29-31.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, lightened from the heavy anna; its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), omitted. ﴿لَنْ يُخْرِجَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿أَضْغانَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar of an, and an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that stands in place of the two objects of حسب. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and law is a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿نَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَأَرَيْناكَهُمْ﴾ the lām falls in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the kāf is its first object and the hāʾ its second object; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَلَعَرَفْتَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, the lām falls in the apodosis of law, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿بِسِيماهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām falls in the answer to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِي لَحْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْقَوْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَعْمالَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām falls in the answer to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and its object, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of causation (taʿlīl) and of the genitive. ﴿نَعْلَمَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit an after حتى, its fāʿil latent. ﴿الْمُجاهِدِينَ﴾ its object; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to what precedes them; the clause la-nabluwannakum is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المجاهدين. ﴿وَالصَّابِرِينَ﴾ conjoined to المجاهدين. ﴿وَنَبْلُوَا﴾ conjoined to نعلم. ﴿أَخْبارَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:32-34.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَصَدُّوا﴾ conjoined to كفروا. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَشَاقُّوا الرَّسُولَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْ﴾ ﴿بَعْدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شاقوا. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (yielding a verbal noun). ﴿تَبَيَّنَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it. ﴿الْهُدى﴾ its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from mā and the verb is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لَنْ يَضُرُّوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (اللَّهِ); as mafʿūl bihi it is اللَّهَ.] ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, standing in for an absolute object). ﴿وَسَيُحْبِطُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ refer to verse no. 7. ﴿أَطِيعُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا تُبْطِلُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿أَعْمالَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ see verse no. 34. [Translator's note: so in the source; this is verse 34 itself, and the parallel analysis is in verse 32 above.] ﴿وَصَدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿ماتُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is circumstantial. ﴿فَلَنْ يَغْفِرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by lan, and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (اللَّهِ); as fāʿil it is اللَّهُ.] ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause inna الذين is initial.

daas-irab:35-37.t: ﴿فَلا تَهِنُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition), and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَتَدْعُوا﴾ conjoined to تهنوا. ﴿إِلَى السَّلْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ a conjunction, and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَلَنْ يَتِرَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan; the kāf is its first object and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَعْمالَكُمْ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿لَعِبٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿وَلَهْوٌ﴾ conjoined to لعب; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and in causes the jussive. ﴿تُؤْمِنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَتَتَّقُوا﴾ conjoined to تؤمنوا. ﴿يُؤْتِكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is latent and the kāf is its first object. ﴿أُجُورَكُمْ﴾ its second object; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا يَسْئَلْكُمْ أَمْوالَكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negative, and يسألكم أموالكم is conjoined to يؤتكم أجوركم. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿يَسْئَلْكُمُوها﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis; its fāʿil is latent, the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi and hā the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial. ﴿فَيُحْفِكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb conjoined to يسألكموها. ﴿تَبْخَلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَيُخْرِجْ﴾ conjoined to تبخلوا. ﴿أَضْغانَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿ها﴾ for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿أَنْتُمْ هؤُلاءِ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿تُدْعَوْنَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِتُنْفِقُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تدعون. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَمِنْكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of resumption and of consequence (tafrīʿ), and minkum is a fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿يَبْخَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a resumptive particle, and man is a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَبْخَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis of the condition, and إنما is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَبْخَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَنْ نَفْسِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِيُّ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ and al-ghaniyy its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنْتُمُ الْفُقَراءُ﴾ conjoined to الله al-ghaniyy. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and in is a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿تَتَوَلَّوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is initial. ﴿يَسْتَبْدِلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿غَيْرَكُمْ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive, and its noun. ﴿أَمْثالَكُمْ﴾ its khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
